author: Corridor Crew
description:
Corridor Crew's Sam has gone on a quest to find the most bad-good action movies with wildly inflated budgets. This scene from Gunner, starring Luke Hemsworth, has the potential to become a truly unforgettable moment in action movie history.

Do you think you'll be able to forget it?
title: Isn't this the MOST incredible action scene YOU'VE EVER SEEN?
